sentences.en: My name's Liz Fuller and I'm a running coach with Compton Park Runners Club.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是莉兹·富勒，我是康普顿公园跑者俱乐部的一名跑步教练。

sentences.en: Welcome to my podcast.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听我的播客节目。

sentences.en: If you're thinking about taking up running - I'm here to help.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在考虑开始跑步——我在这里就是为了帮助你。

sentences.en: There are many training programmes available online which aim to help people build up to running 5 kilometres.
sentences.zh: 网上有许多训练计划，旨在帮助人们逐步达到跑完5公里的目标。

sentences.en: Some of them are great and thousands of people of all ages are taking part in 5-kilometre races across the country as a result.
sentences.zh: 其中一些计划非常出色，成千上万、各个年龄段的人因此参加了遍布全国的5公里比赛。

sentences.en: People like them because they're easy to follow and don't push them too hard.
sentences.zh: 人们喜欢这些计划，是因为它们易于遵循，且不会让人感到过度吃力。

sentences.en: However, they don't work for everyone - especially if /12 you suffer from something like a heart condition or asthma, because they're aimed at people with average fitness and running ability.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们并不适用于所有人——尤其是如果你患有心脏病或哮喘等疾病，因为这些计划面向的是具备一般体能和跑步能力的人群。

sentences.en: Another thing iS that everyone is different - and if you /12 have any specific questions related to your needs, there's no one to provide any answers.
sentences.zh: 另一点是，每个人的情况都不同——如果你有关于自身需求的具体问题，这些计划中并没有人能为你提供解答。

sentences.en: have a couple of simple tips I always give to new runners.
sentences.zh: 我有几个简单建议，总是会分享给初学跑步者。

sentences.en: I expect you've been told to run very slowly until your fitness increases - well, I find that can prevent progress.
sentences.zh: 你可能已被告知：在体能提升之前应以极慢的速度跑步——但我觉得这反而会阻碍进步。

sentences.en: You should run at a speed that feels comfortable, but time yourself and try to a run a bit faster each ime.
sentences.zh: 你应该以一种感觉舒适的速度跑步，但需计时，并尝试每次跑得稍快一点。

sentences.en: Listening to music can be very helpful - it takes your mind off things and helps your body get /14 into a rhythm.
sentences.zh: 听音乐会非常有帮助——它能让你转移注意力，并帮助身体进入节奏。

sentences.en: I'd say that is better than running with a friend - especially as most people are Audioscripts competitive and that's not what you want when you're just starting.
sentences.zh: 我认为这比与朋友一起跑步效果更好——尤其因为大多数人具有竞争性，而你在刚开始时并不需要这种氛围。

sentences.en: I don't think the time of day is especially important - some people are better in the evening, while others are morning people but you need to be consistent, so aim to train regularly - twice a week is enough to /14 begin with.
sentences.zh: 我认为一天中何时跑步并非特别重要——有些人晚上状态更好，而另一些人则是晨型人；但你需要保持规律性，因此目标是定期训练——每周两次就足以起步了。

sentences.en: New members often say to me that they've been put off running either because they lack confidence, or they don't have time, or they think they dislike running.
sentences.zh: 新会员常向我反映，他们之所以对跑步望而却步，要么是因为缺乏信心，要么是因为没时间，要么是认为自己不喜欢跑步。

sentences.en: Ceri, for example, joined the club two years ago at the age of 40.
sentences.zh: 例如，塞里两年前以40岁的年龄加入了本俱乐部。

sentences.en: She'd always enjoyed running at school but wasn't sure if she'd be able to do it.
sentences.zh: 她上学时一直很喜欢跑步，但不确定自己是否还能继续。

sentences.en: She was worried about being left behind and being the slowest runner.
sentences.zh: 她担心会被落在后面，成为最慢的跑者。

sentences.en: But she says she was made to feel so welcome she soon forgot all about that.
sentences.zh: 但她表示，自己一到俱乐部便感受到无比的欢迎，很快便完全忘记了这些顾虑。

sentences.en: James had always hated the idea of running but a friend encouraged him to come along for a taster session and he hasn't looked back.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯一直讨厌跑步这个想法，但一位朋友鼓励他来参加一次体验课，自此他便一发不可收拾。

sentences.en: He never misses a training session despite having a really demanding job.
sentences.zh: 尽管工作极其繁忙，他从不缺席任何一次训练课。

sentences.en: Leo was worried about having to commit himself to training sessions every week and wasn't sure he'd be able to fit training into his busy schedule.
sentences.zh: 利奥则担心必须每周坚持参加训练课，不确定自己能否将训练安排进忙碌的日程中。

sentences.en: But after experiencing a lot of stress at work he came along to us and gave it a go.
sentences.zh: 但在工作中承受了巨大压力后，他来到我们这里尝试了一次。

sentences.en: Now he says he feels much more relaxed and he looks forward to his weekly run.
sentences.zh: 如今他表示自己感觉放松多了，并十分期待每周的跑步。

sentences.en: Mark is quite typical of our new members.
sentences.zh: 马克是我们新会员中相当典型的代表。

sentences.en: He's never considered himself to be a sporty a person and it was only when he retired that he decided to take up the challenge of trying o 5 run 5 kilometres.
sentences.zh: 他从未将自己视为一个热爱运动的人，直到退休后才决定挑战完成5公里跑。

sentences.en: It took him months to find the courage to contact us but felt reassured immediately as there were other people his age who were only just taking up running for the first time.
sentences.zh: 他花了数月时间才鼓起勇气联系我们，但立刻感到安心——因为还有其他同龄人也正首次开始跑步。

sentences.en: My own journey hasn't been easy. did my first marathon when was 37, after having had two kids.
sentences.zh: 我自己的经历也并不轻松。我在37岁时，在生育两个孩子之后完成了人生首场马拉松。

sentences.en: My husband had been running marathons for years, but I never dreamed I'd be doing one with him.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫已跑了多年马拉松，但我做梦也没想过自己会和他一同参赛。

sentences.en: I managed to complete it in four hours, but felt like giving up halfway through - it was only the support of the spectators that kept me going.
sentences.zh: 我最终用四小时完成了比赛，但跑到一半时已想放弃——全靠观众的支持才坚持下来。

sentences.en: I do think signing up for a race of whatever length is motivating - whether it's 5K or 25K - because it's good to have something to work towards and it gives you a sense of achievement. did my first 10K after only six months, which was certainly very challenging and not something I'd necessarily recommend.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为，报名参加一场无论距离长短的比赛都极具激励作用——无论是5公里还是25公里——因为拥有明确目标有助于努力，也能带来成就感。我在仅训练六个月后便完成了首场10公里赛，这当然极具挑战性，也未必是我会推荐的做法。

sentences.en: But after you've been training for a few weeks, it's worth putting your name down for a 5K some people find they only need a few practice runs before taking part in a race, but I'd give yourself a couple of months at least.
sentences.zh: 但当你训练几周后，不妨报名参加一场5公里比赛。有些人发现只需几次练习跑便可参赛，但我建议至少给自己留出两个月时间。

sentences.en: Well, hope that's given ..
sentences.zh: 好了，希望以上内容……
